collection.description: Two tribes remember a shared historical encounter in sharply different ways.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Two tribes remember a shared historical encounter in sharply different ways.

text_only.reason: a celebration talked about or planned in the story; nobody celebrates in the game -- the volume's outcomes are story text unless an effect is marked

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The villagers find common facts amid different interpretations.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: Each group learns that the other remembers a detail they had forgotten.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: An old object supports one small detail but not the entire story.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The artifacts raise new questions rather than settling the dispute.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: Children hear how memory and perspective shape history.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (elder) worries the differences will confuse children, prompting a thoughtful exchange.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The tribes enjoy a meal without agreeing about the past.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: A friendly argument continues over dessert, now with more mutual respect.
